heading: The Parlor
intro: Meaning “heaven-like,” we believe in using naturally produced, sustainable and earth friendly products. We believe our passion is our purpose, and virtue over vanity.

members.name: Kayla Dar
members.title: Extension Specialist · Glamour Consultant
bio: Kayla began Empyrean Beauty with 23 years of experience, 3,300 hours and a passion for continuing education, including study alongside celebrity stylists.
Hair extensions are her specialty: from the first consultation, matching colour, length and density, through installation and the move-ups that keep them looking like your own hair.
With a deep love for glamour and fashion, Kayla also believes deeply in using products that are environmentally friendly — the same standard she holds for everything that touches a guest's hair.
